responsibility: Declares the Resolver2_0 Early pass responsible for pre-body name resolution of macros and macro-like attributes in the Rust frontend. The class extends DefaultResolver with a go entry point, override hooks for macro definitions, macro invocations, and scope-bearing constructs, plus an internal TextualScope stack that models Rust’s textual macro scoping separately from path-based namespace lookup and exposes collected macro-resolution errors to later stages.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Early resolver pass API, its override points for macro definitions, invocations, and scope-bearing constructs, plus the nested TextualScope helper and error accessors; the paired .cc file provides the actual macro-resolution algorithm and mapping updates.
